title: Nightmare Horror Investigation
description:
NIGHTMARE HORROR INVESTIGATIONYou are sent by the government to investigate a series of strange and unexplained events. What begins as a simple investigation quickly turns into a fight for survival.

Explore abandoned and dangerous locations, uncover scattered notes, investigate the traces left behind by those who came before you, and try to understand what is really happening.

Not everyone you encounter will survive.

Investigate the UnknownExplore 11 different locations, each with its own atmosphere, dangers, secrets, and events to discover.

Throughout your investigation, you will find notes left behind by people who were there before you. Reading them can reveal important information about what happened and help you piece together the mystery surrounding the events.

Some people are still alive when you arrive. Others are already gone.

And sometimes, what you witness may be far more disturbing than what you find written on a piece of paper.

Explore, Investigate, SurviveSearch your surroundings for useful items, keys, ammunition, money, and other resources.

Keys can unlock new areas and allow you to continue exploring deeper into the investigation.

Your resources are limited, so every decision matters. Ammunition, weapons, and medical supplies can make the difference between surviving an encounter and becoming another victim.

Manage Your ResourcesMoney can be used at shops to purchase essential supplies such as:

• Ammunition

• Medical kits

Choose how you use your resources and prepare yourself for what lies ahead.

There are only four weapons available throughout the entire game, making ammunition management an important part of survival.

Different Enemies, Different ThreatsYou will encounter several types of enemies throughout your investigation.

Some enemies possess unique attacks and abilities, while others present different challenges that require you to adapt to the situation.

Not every combat encounter is the same. Some events involve more than just you and your enemies, creating unpredictable situations where survival depends on what happens around you.

A Dark and Unpredictable JourneyThe investigation takes you through environments filled with darkness, rain, thunderstorms, strange events, abandoned locations, and the remains of people who were unable to escape.

There are moments of danger, moments of mystery, and moments where you may question what you are actually seeing.

Some events may even take place in strange dreamlike or nightmare-like situations.

AtmosphereThe game features atmospheric music designed specifically for different situations and locations.

Rain, thunder, environmental sounds, distant events, and carefully placed music help create an unsettling atmosphere as you progress through the investigation.

There are also a small number of sudden scares waiting for you along the way.

Not Everything Is What It SeemsAs you investigate, you may encounter situations that don't fit what you expect from a horror investigation.

Some moments are disturbing.

Some are mysterious.

And, on rare occasions, things can become strangely absurd.

Key Features• 11 different locations to explore

• Government investigation storyline

• Survival horror experience

• Exploration and investigation

• Notes and environmental clues

• Multiple types of enemies

• Enemies with unique attacks and abilities

• Four weapons

• Ammunition management

• Money and supply management

• Shops for ammunition and medical supplies

• Keys and locked areas to discover

• Combat events with different situations

• Survivors and story encounters

• Nightmare and dreamlike sequences

• Rain, thunderstorms, and atmospheric environments

• Original atmospheric music

• Scene-based saving system

• Dark humor hidden within the horror

• English voice acting

• Spanish subtitles available

How Far Will You Go to Uncover the Truth?The investigation begins with a simple objective: find out what happened.

But the deeper you go, the more questions appear.

Follow the clues. 
Read what was left behind. 
Manage your resources. 
Survive the encounters. 
And uncover the truth behind the nightmare.

Your investigation has only just begun.
description_short: A survival horror adventure where you investigate terrifying locations, face deadly enemies, explore a mysterious world, and fight to survive. Discover secrets, manage your weapons and resources, and uncover the dark truth behind the nightmare.
